title: UAP secrecy justified under a law enforcement provision
summary: Michael Shellenberger tells of UAP secrecy justified under a law enforcement provision, about an unknown time at United States (no place named), and reports it citing named sources. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he noticed that they are justifying secrecy under a law enforcement provision rather than just National Security

plain: A journalist named Michael Shellenberger, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, passes on something a researcher named John Greenwald noticed. Greenwald collects government records. According to Shellenberger, Greenwald saw that the US government was keeping its files on UAP (the official term for UFOs, unidentified anomalous phenomena) secret under a rule meant for law enforcement, not just under the usual national security grounds. If that is right, the secrecy may rest on a different legal footing than people would expect.
